candidate_a.name: multi-channel e-commerce month-close/reconciliation
candidate_a.payment_or_commitment: unproven for exact wedge; comparable accounting outsourcing has paid_transaction evidence
candidate_a.target_segment: Taiwan company using website plus multiple e-commerce channels

evidence_items.limitation: budget/proposal count are not payment; one buyer request
internal labor, not external demand by itself
comparable accounting service, not exact e-commerce exception package
proves invoice/refund requirements, not pain or demand

candidate_a.recurrence_trigger: monthly close, refund/allowance events and accountant handoff
candidate_a.recurrence_type: same-customer and cross-customer plausible; month-two repeat unproven
candidate_a.standardizable_unit: channel intake map, exception taxonomy, QA checklist and accountant handoff pack
candidate_a.leverage_path: templates/rules, standardized intake, trained QA and selective automation
candidate_a.regulatory_boundary: data preparation/QA/handoff may be a safer test boundary; formal bookkeeping, tax filing/advice/representation requires qualified scope review
contradictions: bookkeeping firms/ERP integrations may already cover the layer
exact wedge has no completed payment evidence
candidate_a.next_test: one-month redacted-data reconciliation pack with fixed scope, via Tasker/PRO360/referral/community; seek accepted quote/continuation, not survey interest

candidate_b.name: fixed-scope e-commerce back-office operations
candidate_b.payment_or_commitment: broad category paid_transaction observed; exact fixed package unproven
candidate_b.target_segment: Taiwan e-commerce business seeking long-term channel operations

evidence_items.limitation: displayed budget/request not payment; exact execution scope is one listing
broad scopes and budgets; completion/payment not verified
broad e-commerce outsourcing category, not fixed package

candidate_b.recurrence_trigger: daily/weekly listings, orders, customer replies, inventory/returns and campaign cycles
candidate_b.recurrence_type: same-customer plausible; task mix and volume unproven
candidate_b.standardizable_unit: one platform, fixed SKU/order band, response SLA and exception queue
candidate_b.leverage_path: SOPs, batching, templates, trained operators and selective automation
candidate_b.regulatory_boundary: lower formal accounting risk if limited to platform operations; do not promise tax/accounting compliance
candidate_b.next_phase_condition: Only revisit as a startup if two buyers accept the same narrow bundle and measured operator-hours stay bounded; otherwise keep as service.

strongest_evidence: Recent Tasker buyer request explicitly names multi-channel reconciliation, refunds/allowances, monthly reporting and long-term outsourcing.
Recent Tasker e-commerce assistant request explicitly names execution-only operations, orders, listings, replies and shipping.
PRO360 category reviews/payment workflow prove external service categories exist, but not the exact proposed wedges.
weakest_claims: Exact-wedge payment or accepted commitment for either finalist.
Whether an unlicensed operator can safely perform every intended reconciliation task.
unsupported_precision: No TAM, CAC, LTV, conversion, retention, exact savings or margin estimate.

research_saturation.decision: Stop broad desk research; test A in the real world, keep B as service unless a narrower package earns repeatable commitment.
